# OpInterface definitions
## BinaryArithOpInterface (`BinaryArithOpInterface`)

A binary f64 arithmetic operation that can be evaluated on constant
operands. Implemented by toy.add, toy.mul and toy.sub.

### Methods:
#### `evaluate`

```c++
double evaluate(double lhs, double rhs);
```
Evaluate the op on two constant operands.

NOTE: This method *must* be implemented by the user.

#### `getSymbol`

```c++
::llvm::StringRef getSymbol();
```
The operator symbol, for diagnostics.

NOTE: This method *must* be implemented by the user.

#### `isCommutative`

```c++
bool isCommutative();
```
Whether the operands may be swapped.

NOTE: This method *must* be implemented by the user.

#### `getLhsValue`

```c++
::mlir::Value getLhsValue();
```
The left operand.


#### `getRhsValue`

```c++
::mlir::Value getRhsValue();
```

The right operand.
